The G-Shock Mid-Size GM-S2100CH-1AJF Black Watch combines rugged durability with a sleek, modern design to suit both active lifestyles and everyday wear. This timepiece offers excellent shock resistance and water resistance up to 200 meters, making it perfect for outdoor adventures and daily use alike. Its black stainless steel bezel and comfortable resin band provide both style and practicality.

Featuring precise quartz movement, the G-Shock Mid-Size GM-S2100CH-1AJF ensures accurate timekeeping while maintaining a lightweight feel for all-day comfort. Whether you're heading to work, exercising, or exploring the outdoors, this watch delivers reliable performance with a refined aesthetic.

Details

  • Product Material: Stainless Steel, Resin
  • Manufacturer: Casio

Features

  • Shock resistant design protects against impacts and vibrations
  • Water resistant up to 200 meters, suitable for swimming and snorkeling
  • Durable stainless steel bezel combined with a comfortable resin band
  • Accurate quartz movement for reliable timekeeping
  • Sleek black design that complements various styles and occasions

How to use

To use the G-Shock Mid-Size GM-S2100CH-1AJF Black Watch, wear it comfortably on your wrist and adjust the resin band for a secure fit. Set the time according to the instructions in the user manual to ensure accurate timekeeping. The watch is designed to withstand shocks and water exposure, but avoid pressing buttons underwater to maintain water resistance.

Care instructions

Clean the watch regularly by wiping it with a soft, damp cloth to remove dirt and sweat. Avoid using harsh chemicals or solvents that could damage the resin band or stainless steel bezel. Store the watch in a cool, dry place when not in use and avoid exposing it to extreme temperatures for prolonged periods.
